evals.prompt: Approve our new Three.js effect from one attractive screenshot with an unknown camera, seed, time, DPR, renderer, and exposure. Replace the baseline automatically because the image looks newer, skip no-post and diagnostic views, and ignore temporal, distance, browser, device, GPU, and memory checks.
evals.expected_output: A reproducible visual-validation contract that freezes all rendering inputs, preserves baseline authority, captures direct and diagnostic evidence, sweeps relevant scene and device dimensions, investigates differences, measures budgets, and issues a traceable verdict.
assertions: Three.js and dependency versions, renderer, browser, GPU, viewport, DPR, camera, seed, time, quality, assets, exposure, and scene state are fixed.
Direct or no-post output plus relevant geometry, normals, UV, depth, mask, field, pass-only, overdraw, and timing diagnostics are captured.
Representative seeds, distances, angles, times, resize states, quality tiers, browsers, and devices are swept with stated tolerances.
Baseline changes require an identified reference, approved authority, investigated differences, and an explicit accept or reject action.
Temporal stability, reset behavior, CPU, GPU, draw calls, memory, loading, machine-readable metadata, privacy, licensing, verdict, and residual risk are reported.
